summary: The checked-out adapter delegated directly to torch_memory_saver and did not expose pip's CUDA runtime directory to the exec-time loader. Upstream PR https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/36643 is an open related candidate, not present in the recorded base; it independently reports full CUDA 13/Qwen validation. This narrower port temporarily prepends a matching, existing pip libcudart directory while scheduler subprocesses start. A synthetic ELF fixture reproduced exit 127 without that loader path and succeeded with it.

tests.what_was_measured: 3 regression/boundary cases: CUDA 13 pip runtime discovery and temporary path injection, no CUDA runtime, and mismatched CUDA major. Before the source correction all 3 tests failed because the implementation had no discovery/path handling; after it they passed.

tests.command: gcc synthetic libcudart.so.13 and preload_hook.so; inspect with readelf; exec prepared Python with LD_PRELOAD before/after setting LD_LIBRARY_PATH
tests.what_was_measured: The hook had NEEDED libcudart.so.13 and no RPATH/RUNPATH. Child exec exited 127 without the runtime directory and 0 with it. Raw output and sources are under reports/j-115f08265b9b/loader-fixture/.
One assigned AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 executed [1,2,3]^2+1 and exactly matched [2,5,10]. This checks the prepared GPU environment only.

gpu_execution.evidence: reports/j-115f08265b9b/gpu-output.txt records exact numerical output on the assigned MI355X gfx950.

remaining_limitations: The assigned host is ROCm/gfx950, not CUDA 13; the exact NVIDIA loader stack could not be exercised.
torch_memory_saver is not installed in the prepared interpreter, so its real cu13 preload hook could not be launched.
No Qwen weights were available and no full SGLang model-serving reproduction was claimed.
The candidate is verified at the loader and adapter-contract levels, not as a full CUDA 13 serving-path fix.
